name: Cartographer Spells
description:
When you reach an Artificer level specified in the Cartographer Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Level 3: Faerie Fire, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word

Level 5: Locate Object, Mind Spike

Level 9: Call Lightning, Clairvoyance

Level 13: Banishment, Locate Creature

Level 17: Scrying, Teleportation Circle
